historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (20.6% 5yr, 26.6% 3yr) is not an operating growth measure: it is inflated by the 2021 equity raise and the FY2025 US$416m SHPL divestment gain. EPS was negative in FY2019-FY2022, and owner FCF has been negative in every year except FY2023 (licensing windfall), so EPS and FCF CAGRs are undefined. Revenue 3yr CAGR selected; the 5yr figure (19.2%) is flattered by the FY2020 base and the FY2023 Takeda upfront.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF history (reported FCF - SBC - interest income, US$m): FY2021 -225; FY2022 -345; FY2023 +114 (Takeda US$400m deal year); FY2024 -79; FY2025 -144 (divestment tax distortion). No positive-to-positive span exists for a CAGR.

scenario_narratives.base: FRUZAQLA keeps compounding ex-US royalties through its 41-country rollout, the China commercial reset holds (H1 2026 in-market +32%), savolitinib adds 3L MET-amplified gastric cancer and sovleplenib launches in ITP/wAIHA in China, while Other Ventures distribution shrinks. SAFFRON/SANOVO produce mixed results, and the ATTC platform earns the GSK upfront and modest milestones only. R&D stays near US$160-200m, so the operating business climbs slowly from breakeven to a ~22% pre-SBC EBITDA margin over a decade. The US$1.37bn cash pile is most of today's value; the operating franchise adds roughly the remainder.
scenario_narratives.bull: SAFFRON reads out positive in H2 2026 and supports global savolitinib filings with AstraZeneca; GSK advances HMPL-A830 and milestones flow; HMPL-A251/A580 secure a second multinational partnership; FRUZAQLA ex-US growth stays high and sovleplenib becomes a meaningful China immunology product. O/I revenue roughly doubles within five years, royalty-heavy mix carries margins to ~30%, and licensing income recurs rather than spiking once.
scenario_narratives.bear: SAFFRON fails after SAMETA, NRDL renegotiations and domestic competitors (Hengrui, BeiGene, Innovent) compress ELUNATE/SULANDA/ORPATHYS pricing, FRUZAQLA royalties plateau as Lonsurf/regorafenib and newer CRC regimens hold share, ATTC data disappoint and GSK hands back A830, and leadership uncertainty (CEO on leave) slows partnering. The company keeps spending on R&D to defend its pipeline, so margins stay in low single digits and the cash pile, not the franchise, is the floor. Geopolitical scrutiny of China-originated biotech licensing (BIOSECURE-style) caps future deal flow.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value = net cash (US$1.28bn, ~HK$11.5/share) + the GSK upfront less SHPL obligations + a DCF of the operating franchise built from near-breakeven margins today. Owner-FCF basis: SBC fully expensed, interest income stripped because the cash is in the bridge, the SHPL divestment gain excluded from earnings power. Pipeline optionality (GSK milestones, SAFFRON, further ATTC deals) is priced through the bull scenario rather than a separate rNPV.
key_risks_to_valuation: Operating value is long-dated: margins are ~breakeven today, so terminal value carries most of the franchise value
Binary clinical readouts (SAFFRON, SANOVO, ATTC Phase I) swing the bull/bear weights
NRDL price cuts and domestic competition in China oncology
Cash is in PRC/HK entities; PRC FX controls apply to part of the balance
SHPL profit-guarantee provision could rise to its US$103.5m cap
CEO on leave of absence; acting CEO is also CFO

inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted weighted ordinary shares, H1 2026 interim (872,869,494); 872,335,120 issued at 30-Jun-2026. Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows. HUTCHMED does not repurchase for cancellation; the only buyback-like outflows (FY2020-FY2024, nil since H1 2025) are LTIP trust purchases to satisfy awards, i.e. the cash form of SBC. Flat count is a modelling convention the company funds only partly.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash-flow add-back (share-based compensation, US$15.3m); no net-share-settlement tax line (EquityAwardTaxes = 0 every period). H1 2026 SBC US$5.0m (1.8% of revenue).
inputs.fx_note: Flows and statements in USD (US GAAP, US$'000 rescaled to millions); HKEX quote in HKD. USD->HKD 7.8472 from Yahoo HKD=X at 2026-10-10T04:21Z (pegged band 7.75-7.85, so the rate cannot rot far). Parity check: Nasdaq ADS HCM US$14.10 (2026-10-09 close) / 5 shares per ADS x 7.8472 = HK$22.13 vs 0013.HK HK$21.74 (1.8% gap, ADS closed ~12h later). ADS ratio confirmed by H1 2026 diluted EPS US$0.02/share vs US$0.09/ADS. All per-share values computed in USD and converted; unsuffixed values are HKD.
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, so a USD build: US 10y ~4.3% + 1.15 beta x 5.0% ERP + ~0.5pp China-domicile premium ~ 10.5%. Effectively all-equity (US$94.5m bank debt against US$1.37bn cash), so WACC = cost of equity. Same rate in all three scenarios: binary pipeline risk is charged in the scenario flows and the 25% bear weight, not again in the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP filer: operating-lease cost already sits inside operating expenses (EBITDA). Lease liabilities (~US$4.7m at FY2025) are excluded from net debt. One treatment, charged once.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (Other Ventures subsidiaries carry small minorities). NCI deducted once in the equity bridge at book (US$14.2m, 30-Jun-2026); immaterial (<1% of equity value).
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF (operating-company route) plus explicit equity-bridge items. HUTCHMED is a commercial-stage biopharma whose revenue is now dominated by recurring product sales, royalties and manufacturing revenue (FRUZAQLA, ELUNATE, SULANDA, ORPATHYS) plus a low-margin drug-distribution segment; it is not a bank/REIT/holdco and is not pre-revenue, so the owner-FCF route applies. The lumpy elements are handled outside the run-rate: (1) the FY2025 SHPL divestment gain (US$477.5m pre-tax, US$416.3m net) is excluded entirely -- its cash is already in the US$1.37bn net cash, and the residual 5% SHPL stake and the US$83.6m profit-guarantee provision are bridged separately; (2) the September 2026 GSK HMPL-A830 upfront (US$110m) is bridged as a discrete after-tax receipt, not compounded into the revenue base; the further ~US$1.185bn of GSK milestones are contingent and appear only as higher licensing revenue in the bull path. BASE YEAR: FY2025 reported FCF (-78.8) is distorted by ~US$45m of divestment cash tax and a US$10m milestone payment; owner FCF on it is -144 (-78.8 - 15.3 SBC - 49.9 interest income). H1 2026 is the cleaner run-rate: EBITDA +7.9 (incl. an $18.1m Lilly milestone), pre-SBC 12.9 = 4.6% margin, owner FCF annualised ~ -45 after stripping ~US$48m/yr of interest income. Projections are built from components, so last_fcf is informational. Interest income (~US$50m/yr on US$1.37bn) is stripped because the cash is added in the bridge. Revenue path blends Oncology/Immunology growing ~10-12%/yr (FY2026 guidance US$330-450m; H1 US$162.3m) with Other Ventures shrinking ~5%/yr (H1 US$116.0m, being de-emphasised). Working capital is negative capture (distributor and manufacturer: receivables + inventory > payables). CEO Weiguo Su on leave; CFO Johnny Cheng acting CEO.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 ~flat total revenue: O/I ~US$330m ex-GSK (bottom of the US$330-450m guidance) offset by Other Ventures falling ~14%. Thereafter O/I +10-12% (FRUZAQLA ex-US royalties, ELUNATE/SULANDA rebound, savolitinib GC, sovleplenib ITP/wAIHA launches) against OV -5%, blending to 5-6%.
base.margin_rationale: Pre-SBC EBITDA ~breakeven today (FY2025 -1.9%, H1 2026 4.6% incl. a milestone). Royalty/product mix and R&D held near US$160-200m lift margin to 22% by year 9; a component sketch of the mature mix supports ~29%, haircut for R&D re-investment and NRDL price cuts.
base.tax_rationale: Cash tax ex-divestment ~US$15-18m/yr on small profits; group has accumulated losses. Ramp to ~16% (China HNTE 15% / HK 16.5% blend).

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 14x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 25% (above the 15% default) because value beyond the cash rests on binary readouts (SAMETA already failed in March 2026; SAFFRON/SANOVO pending) and NRDL pricing, with an acting CEO. Base 50%. Bull 25% (below the 35% default) because it needs several independent things to go right at once: a SAFFRON win, GSK milestones and a second ATTC deal.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
